Rae (Support): Escalation: Harborlytics trial tenant harbor-try-12 failing seat activation. Seeing a spike of 502s from /v1/provision and repeated 429s on embeddings. Customers can't complete onboarding. Escalating to CS for comms + priority unblock.
Miles (CS Lead): Thanks Rae. Any short-term mitigations we can offer while infra investigates?
Rae (Support): We attempted API key rotation and increased retries; only temporary. Logs show provisioner queue backlog. Tagging SEs and infra.
Sam (Solutions Eng): We can enable a controlled reroute to a fallback provision pool to allow activations at reduced throughput. Internal command: curl -X POST /internal/reroute -d '{"tenant":"harbor-try-12","target_pool":"fallback-provision","expires_in":10800}'
Anika (CSM): This account had recent expansion signals — want a rapid customer touch. Recommend a 30m sync and a short proactive note offering credits if activation is delayed.
Miles (CS Lead): Approve reroute. Rae, please apply once infra gives the all-clear to avoid cascading issues. Anika, draft the 10m ack and schedule call. I'll own the renewal outreach if this escalates.
Rae (Support): Infra approved. Applying reroute now; will post back in 2m.
pager-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-2133 (P2) link: internal/playbooks/provisioning-backlog.md
Rae (Support): Reroute applied, API returned 200. Monitoring shows provisioning resumed at limited capacity.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Watching metrics  error rate falling; queue draining. I'll set the reroute to auto-expire at 4h and prepare rollback steps.
Anika (CSM): Invite sent for +28m. Drafted customer message: brief apology, what we did, ETA, invite to call, and note about credits. Pasting to private notes.
Miles (CS Lead): Thanks team. Keep updates concise. After resolution, we'll do a short postmortem and add a one-paragraph onboarding note that includes the reroute CLI so CSMs can act faster next time.
Rae (Support): Customer confirmed first seat added during call. Monitoring continues; will close once infra confirms full fix.
